en_title: Sony's Spider-Man Spinoff Universe Might Be Dead as Company Confirms It Has No Movies in Active Development
cn_title: 索尼《蜘蛛侠》衍生宇宙或已终结
subtitle: 漫威支线熄火？
opus_summary: 索尼影业高管Tom Rothman确认，索尼漫威电影业务没有处于积极开发阶段的电影。随着《Madame Web》《Morbius》和《Kraven the Hunter》等作品表现不佳，索尼可能重新考虑蜘蛛侠衍生角色的未来。

paragraphs.en: It looks like Sony's Spider-Man spinoff universe may have come to an end after films like Madame Web , Morbius , and Kraven the Hunter failed to satisfy audiences.
paragraphs.cn: 在《Madame Web》《Morbius》和《Kraven the Hunter》等电影未能让观众满意后，索尼的《蜘蛛侠》衍生宇宙看起来可能已经走到尽头。

paragraphs.en: Sony Pictures chairman and CEO Tom Rothman confirmed its corner of Marvel moviemaking is currently without a plan during an interview with Variety . While the Venom trilogy starring Tom Hardy generally managed to find success at the box office, the critical and commercial reception for projects like Madame Web (2024) and Kraven the Hunter (2024) has the company reconsidering their future.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼影业董事长兼首席执行官Tom Rothman在接受《综艺》采访时确认，索尼负责的漫威电影业务目前没有计划。虽然Tom Hardy主演的《Venom》三部曲总体上取得了票房成功，但《Madame Web》（2024年）和《Kraven the Hunter》（2024年）等项目在口碑和商业表现上的反响，已经让公司重新考虑这些作品的未来。

paragraphs.en: "Right now, we don’t know," Rothman said when asked if there are plans to expand on Sony's universe of Spider-Man characters. "We never looked at it as the 'Sony-Marvel Universe.' We looked at if there were worthwhile movies to make with other characters. At the moment, there are none in active development."
paragraphs.cn: 当被问及是否计划扩展索尼的蜘蛛侠角色宇宙时，Rothman说：「现在，我们不知道。我们从未把它视为『Sony-Marvel宇宙』，而是考虑是否有值得用其他角色制作的电影。目前没有任何项目处于积极开发阶段。」

paragraphs.en: Rothman elaborated, saying that "the audience wasn't satisfied enough" with the live-action movies that filled out what many referred to as the "Sony-verse." Starting with Hardy's Venom in 2018, the full roster included that film, Venom: Let There Be Carnage , Morbius, Madame Web, Venom: The Last Dance , and Kraven the Hunter. Although Sony had, at one point, planned to integrate Spider-Man into the villain-led offshoots, such a crossover never came to fruition .
paragraphs.cn: Rothman进一步解释说，观众对构成许多人所谓「Sony-verse」的真人电影「不够满意」。从2018年的Tom Hardy版《Venom》开始，完整阵容包括该片、《Venom: Let There Be Carnage》《Morbius》《Madame Web》《Venom: The Last Dance》和《Kraven the Hunter》。虽然索尼一度计划让蜘蛛侠加入这些由反派主导的衍生作品，但这样的交叉计划从未实现。

paragraphs.en: Kraven arrived as the final attempt to gain traction amongst comic book movie fans when it premiered in December 2024, but like many of the other Sony Spider-Man spinoffs, it failed to make an impact. Starring Marvel alum Aaron Taylor-Johnson, the film opened as the worst-performing entry in the Sony Marvel film series , with reviewers – including IGN – walking away less than impressed.
paragraphs.cn: 《Kraven the Hunter》于2024年12月首映时，被视为吸引漫画电影粉丝的最后尝试，但和索尼其他许多《蜘蛛侠》衍生电影一样，它未能产生影响。这部由漫威老将Aaron Taylor-Johnson主演的电影，首映时成为索尼漫威电影系列表现最差的一部，包含IGN在内的影评人看完后都不太满意。

paragraphs.en: Despite the memes made along the way , it sounds like the poor performance has Sony rethinking how it uses these characters. Rothman's words today suggest his reboot teases from earlier this year might be on hold for a long while to come, if they materialize at all, after the movies failed to connect with audiences the first time around. At least there's still an animated Venom movie on the way .
paragraphs.cn: 尽管一路上产生了不少梗图，但听起来糟糕的表现已经让索尼重新思考如何使用这些角色。Rothman今天的说法表明，即便今年早些时候预告的重启项目最终真的出现，也可能会被搁置很长时间，毕竟这些电影第一次尝试时没能与观众产生联系。至少，一部《Venom》动画电影仍在制作中。

paragraphs.en: "Whether that’s a fair assessment of those movies, who know," Rothman added, touching on the lack of impact on audiences. "That’s howling into the wind. The audience is the boss, and they didn’t respond. It’s as simple as that."
paragraphs.cn: 谈到这些电影对观众缺乏影响时，Rothman补充道：「不知道这样评价那些电影是否公平。那就像对着风嚎叫。观众才是老板，而他们没有回应。事情就是这么简单。」

paragraphs.en: For now, the main Spider-Man universe is going strong. Spider-Man: Brand New Day just broke records in theaters , prompting Rothman to take a shot at the anti-theater sentiment that's driven conversations amongst moviegoers the last few years. For more, you can check out IGN's full breakdown for every Spider-Man universe movie in development .
paragraphs.cn: 目前，主线《蜘蛛侠》宇宙仍在强势发展。《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》刚刚在影院打破纪录，促使Rothman抨击过去几年推动观众讨论的反影院情绪。想了解更多，可以查看IGN对每部正在开发的《蜘蛛侠》宇宙电影的完整梳理。
